readout: FANA synthesis rate, normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent (fold)
assay_method: Polymerase kinetic profiling (PKPro). 20 nM polymerase, 1 uM 30-mer DNA template, 100 uM each NTP, 1x ThermoPol buffer, 2x LC Green Plus; denature 95 degC 3 min, extend 55 degC 30 min, fluorescence every 6 s; rate from a linear fit of nucleotides per polymerase vs time; mean of three independent replicates.
remark: No WT row: the readout is already normalized to the Tgo-D4K parent, which is 1.0 by definition. The reference sequence is the engineered Tgo-D4K parent, not native Tgo. Position 659 follows the source data, which carries Y and lists the variant as Y659E; the paper text instead calls it H659E. Q93A is listed twice with values differing by 7e-5, and the mean is used.

protein: E4B / Ube4b U-box domain (E3 ubiquitin-protein ligase)
readout: Auto-ubiquitination enrichment in T7 phage display; higher is more active
assay_method: Deep mutational scanning of the E4B U-box domain displayed on T7 phage. The library was made by doped oligo synthesis at a 2 percent per-position error rate; phage were selected for Flag-ubiquitin binding to anti-Flag beads, so enrichment reports the domain's own auto-ubiquitination activity. Full-length variants were linked to 18-base DNA barcodes by subassembly, and barcodes counted at four timepoints in two replicates. Per-variant scores were taken from the authors' MaveDB deposit, Enrich2 amino-acid set.
remark: The target is the 102-residue U-box domain of E4B, not the full protein, and the library came from doped oligo synthesis at a 2 percent error rate, so most variants carry several substitutions: the shipped file runs from 1 to 10 sites per genotype, joined with ':', and multi-site genotypes are 99 percent of it. 8,614 rows are dropped for carrying a premature stop, a readthrough of the terminator at position 103, or being synonymous at the protein level; 0 carry no usable score and 1 are the deposit's own aggregate marker rows. The wild-type row is the deposit's _wt entry. Of the deposit's three score sets this is the amino-acid Enrich2 set, chosen because it carries the wild-type row and per-replicate scores; a-1 is the Enrich analysis as published in 2013 over the same measurements and is not shipped so the experiment is not curated twice, and a-2 is nucleotide-level, which this format cannot express.
